articles.title: UK PM Starmer heading to China aiming to reset ties
articles.mainIdea: UK PM Starmer heading to China aiming to reset ties
articles.summary: AFP: UK PM Starmer heading to China aiming to reset ties. UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer travels to China late Tuesday for the first official visit by a British premier since 2018 as he bids to boost trade ties despite frictions.Starmer's trip follows finance minister Rachel Reeves's visit to Beijing last year, as the centre-left Labour government looks to improve trade relations and fulfil its primary goal of boosting UK economic growth.
